description: This file contains implementation of TensorType and related shape and stride utilities for PyTorch's ATen library, including functions for shape merging, stride computation, and tensor property matching.

classes.name: TensorType
classes.description: Represents tensor type information including shape, strides, device, and data type.

classes.name: VaryingShape
classes.description: Template class for shapes with variable or symbolic dimensions.

classes.name: ShapeSymbol
classes.description: Represents symbolic shape dimensions, static or dynamic.

classes.name: Stride
classes.description: Represents stride information for tensor dimensions.

methods.name: possible_cross_dimension_overlap
methods.description: Checks if there is potential memory overlap across tensor dimensions based on sizes and strides.

methods.name: TensorType::computeStrideProps
methods.description: Computes stride properties for a tensor given sizes and strides, considering contiguity and layout.

methods.name: TensorType::create
methods.description: Factory methods to create TensorType instances from tensor or shape parameters.

methods.name: TensorType::matchTensor
methods.description: Checks if a given tensor matches the type's properties.

methods.name: TensorType::equals
methods.description: Checks if another type is equal to this TensorType.
